observations.claim: Mapper constructor requires service_name; previously inspected entrypoint does not supply it. Static mismatch, not a recorded runtime failure.
Input constraint inference skips simplified parameters without the description marker; simplifier helper was not inspected.
Response schema inference also uses schema metadata, so absent request prose does not imply the entire tool has no usable inputs.
Helper forces gpt-4o and cache keys use prompt hash, without incorporating model or system message. Default call omits explicit output-token bound.

decision: Do not launch the stock end-to-end artifact for this request-rejection comparison. It is unqualified and its response-body target is not a substitute for input validity. Retain it as related work or separately qualify an explicitly adapted response-body comparison.
